topography.project_purpose: Structural profile: 39 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 3 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC1155 multi-tokens, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 4 common project-authored base contract(s) (mtokenstorage, interconnectorleaf, linkageleaf). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
